project.name: career-ops
project.identity: A human-in-the-loop job search command center that turns official postings into evidence-bound fit evaluations, tailored materials, tracker records, and draft-only outreach.
project.audience: Job seekers who want a governed, evidence-backed application workflow rather than spray-and-pray automation.
project.core_loop: Resolve an official posting, evaluate fit against evidence, create tailored PDFs and application materials, update the canonical tracker, and prepare outreach drafts for human review.
project.north_star: High-fit opportunities become clear and actionable while unsupported applications, provider-generated noise, and unsent external actions remain out of the workflow.
not_this: A source of truth based on provider newsletters or stale intermediary links
An agent that submits applications or sends outreach without human control

mvp.definition: An official posting can be resolved, evaluated, tailored into reviewed application artifacts, recorded in the canonical tracker, and accompanied by a Gmail draft without submission or sending.

complete_product.definition: Career Ops reliably manages the evidence-bound lifecycle from official posting discovery through evaluation, tailored materials, tracker reconciliation, draft-only outreach, and human-controlled submission across supported providers.

outcomes.name: A role is promoted only when its official source and fit evidence meet the documented threshold, with unknowns preserved.
